newsitem.title: USA: Molecular Biosystems wins patent review.
newsitem.headline: Molecular Biosystems wins patent review.

text.p: Molecular Biosystems Inc Thursday said the U.S. patent office has granted its request to review a patent held by Sonus Pharmaceuticals Inc.
In a statement, Molecular Biosystems said Sonus claims its patent patent covers certain agents used in ultrasound procedures including Molecular Biosystems's agent Optison.

The patent is number 5,558,094. It was issued to Sonus on September 24, 1996. Molecular Biosystems's petition for reexamination contended the use of certain perfluorocarbon gases for ultrasound imaging, including perfluoropropane, was not patentable because of numerous prior art references.
